(I) (सुब्रह्मण्य)--born in शरकानन or शरवन and was nursed by the six कृत्तिकस्, hence कार्त्ति- keya: Sucking milk with six mouths, the child came to be known as षण्मुख. Appointed commander of the celes- tial army in the तारकासुर war and killed तारक.
1: भा.

. १७.
A son of Agni through स्वाहा, and the son of गन्गा by taking Agni's गर्भ due to Uma's curse. Hence son of शिव.
4: M. १३५. ७९.
His birth was heralded by divine musicians, siddhas, चारणस्, यक्षस्, kinnaras and others. Fed with milk by the wives of the seven sages except अरुन्धती. Hari presented him two birds--fowl and peacock, सरस्वती the lute, ब्राह्मी a goat, and शिव a ram.
5: Br.

. २४; १०. ३५. -४८; M. २०३. 6; वा. ७२. ३५-46.
Married देवसेना, the daughter of Indra: also known as Skanda, Guha, and Deva- सेनापति.
6: Br. IV. ३०. ३९, ९९ to the end; वा. ७२. ४८-50; Br. III. १०. ४८-51.
मयूर as the riding animal of.
7: M. १३५. ७६.
Wounded by Maya in the battle of
(III)--a son of Havya, after whom कुमार- वर्ष was called. Br. II. १४. १७-18; वा. ३३. १६.

(VII)--rose out of the contemplation of ब्रह्मा in the २९थ् कल्प; with white complexion and a resplendant fearful countenance and mouth; ब्रह्मा wor- shipped him as the Gods of Gods, पुराणपुरुष, the best of yogins and laughed a hearty laugh in wonder; also of red colour. वा. २२. १०-23.

(VIII)--at the commencement of the eighth कल्प ब्रह्मा got a son (नीललोहित) who was weeping; he asked ब्रह्मा to give him a name for which ब्रह्मा said रुद्र; again he cried for a second name and ब्रह्मा said, भव; the other names given in order were शिव, पशुपति, ईश, भीम, उग्र and महादेव। वा. २
(X)--a son of Bhavya of शाकद्वीप. Vi.
--a R. from the शुक्तिमत् hill. Vi.

(II)--a सिद्ध who could not com- prehend the supreme Being and who would not find fault with Hara for violating धर्म।
1: भा.

. २०; १५. १२; १७. १२ and ३२; VIII. २३. २०.
Learnt the भागवत from सन्कर्षण and imparted it to सान्ख्यायन.
2: भा.

--a kingdom watered by ह्लादिनी;
1: Br. II. १८. ५५.
a tribe.
2: वा. ४७. ५२.

--the first offspring of ब्रह्मा when he was engaged in thinking of creation devoid of शब्द, स्पर्श, रूप, रस and गन्ध। ब्रह्मा pondered over a form which would be neither male nor female but with colours. Then अक्षर came out of ‘his neck; it was ओङ्कार with one मात्र, then two मात्राक्षर, three अक्षरस्, then fourteen- faced deva and १४ Manus. वा. २६. 8-२८.
--a तीर्थ in the पालपञ्जर hill; sacred for श्राद्ध। वा. ७७. ३७.
--Here पुरूरवस् got separated from उर्वशी. M. २४. १९.
--the son of Madhu, and father of Anu. Vi. IV. १२. ४२. [page१-398+ २६]

(I)--a daughter of ललिता aged nine, and train- ed in military art. Attacked and slew all the sons of भण्ड to the joy of the शक्ति troops;
1: Br. IV. २६. ७३-117.
goddess enshrined at माया- पुरी.
2: M. १३. ३४.
(III)--a R. from the शुक्तिमत् hill. Br. II. १६. ३८; M. १६३. ८६.
(II)--Cape Comorin, fit for श्राद्ध offerings. Br. II. १६. ११; III. १३. २८.
--a part of an artificial fortress (कृत्- रिम)। Br.

--Mt. king of hills, to the east of अरुणोद;
1: वा. ३६. १८; ३७. 1.
eight cities of the दानवस् located in.
2: Ib. ३९. २८-9.

(VIII)--a Mt. on one side of Meru west of शितोद. Here is the celestial Banian Tree शतबलू's from which flow rivers to निलावृत. The tree would yield what- ever was desired of it.
1: भा. V. १६. ११ and २४; वा. ३६. २८; ३८. ४५; ४२. ५१.
One of the seven hills of शाल्मलद्वीप.
2: Br. II. १९. ३५; वा. ४९. ३२-3; Vi.
(XI)--a चक्रवाक in मानस; a son of Kau- शिक in previous birth. M. २०. १८.
(XII)--one of the eight निधिस् of Kubera. वा. ४१. १०.
(I)--a name of योगमाय; the goddess enshrined in मानस. भा.
(II)--the wily sister of महादेव in the isle of Kumuda. वा. ४८. ३५.
--a Janapada of the Bhadra continent. वा. ४३. २१.
(I)--an attendant on Hari. Attacked Asura followers of Bali. See कुमुदाक्षण. भा. VIII. २१. १६; XI. २७. २८.
(II)--an यक्ष and a son of देवयानि. Br.
--a pupil of Pathya. Br. II. ३५. ५९; वा. ६१. ५२; Vi.
--a Janapada of the केतुमाल country. वा. ४४. १२.
--one of the four queens of भण्ड. Br. IV. १२. १३.
(II)--a R. from the Vindhyas. Br. II. १६. ३३; M. ११४. २७; वा. ४५. १०२; ४७. 2.
--(Mt.) a hill range on the east of Meru. Vi.

(I)--a Daitya king, originator of the कापि- लेयस्, दैत्यराक्षसस्; by his wife कपिला;
1: Br.
(II)--a son of मुण्डीश्वर, an अवतार् of the lord of the २५थ् द्वापर। वा. २३. २११.
(III)--helped Soma in the तारकामय war. Vi.
(IV)--a palace in the shape of a pot, with 9 भूमिकस् and a तोरण of १६ हस्तस्। M. २६९. ३७-49.

--a son of विश्रवस् and कैकरी, killed by राम in the लन्का war;
1: भा.
--a son of the मुण्डीश्वर अवतार् of the lord. वा. २३. २११.
--a R. of the केतुमाल country. वा. ४४. २२.
--a name of Agastya. Br. III. ३५. ४२; IV. १७. ३५; ३०. 4.

--a group of पिशाचस्, little in size, hairy, brownish in hue;
1: Br.

. ३७८ and ३८२, ३९५.
are invisible and live on the heads of ele- phants and camels.
2: वा. ६९. २६३, २७४-5.
[page१-403+ ३१]
--a water vessel, being an adjunct of व्रतम्स्: to be given as gift.

(I)--a minister of बाण. His daughter चित्रलेखा, was a companion of ऊषा, बाण's daughter;
1: भा. X. ६२. १४; Vi. V. ३२. १७.
was attacked by बलराम in the siege of शोणितपुर; defeated, ran away.
2: भा. X. ६३, 8 and १६.
Sent to मथुरा for जरासन्ध's help. कृष्ण overcame his illusory warfare by विज्ञानास्त्र। Defeated by सात्यकि, he fell unconscious; was taken from the field in a chariot back to his city.
3: Ib. X. [५१ (V) १८], [२८-30, ५९-63, ६५].
--a hell, for those fallen from Karma. वा. ८३. ८९.
(I)--a daughter of पुष्पोत्कट and विश्रवस्. Br.
(II)--a daughter of Bali, and sister of बाण; ill-treated बाण's wife. M. १८७. ४०-42.
--one of the २८ hells intended for those who deprive a ब्राह्मण of his property, and for flesh and meat-eaters. भा. V. २६. 7 and १३; X. ६४. ३८; Br. II. २८. ८३; III. १९. ६१; M. १४१. ७०.
